scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @dcl/contracts && npm run build -w @dcl/platform
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dcl/api && npm run build -w @dcl/worker && npm run build -w @dcl/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
